source.note: Search summary (results: Wikipedia, breckenridge.com "Breck Mountain Information & Stats", OnTheSnow, GoBreck): 2,908 skiable acres; trails 187 (14% beginner / 31% intermediate / 19% advanced / 36% expert); 20 aerial lifts (1 gondola, 5 detachable six-seat, 8 detachable quad, 1 fixed-grip quad, 1 fixed-grip triple, 4 fixed-grip double chairs) plus 15 surface lifts (4 bar lifts, 1 tow rope, 10 magic carpets; carpets counted as "other"). Total 35 is the sum. Season of the figures not stated.

Slopeside lodging along the Peak 8 and Peak 9 bases. High base elevation (about 9,600 ft) — altitude is a real consideration for visitors from sea level

character: A high-altitude resort spread across Peaks 6 to 10 of the Tenmile Range directly above the historic mining town of Breckenridge. It pairs plenty of groomed intermediate cruising lower down with high alpine bowls, and its base elevation of about 9,600 ft is among the highest in North America.
learning: Reference note: much of the easiest terrain is on lower Peak 9 and around the Peak 8 base, with lessons through the resort ski and ride school. Confirm where first-timers start, carpets and lesson products.

transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: the free Summit County bus has linked Frisco, Breckenridge, Copper Mountain and other Summit County towns. 2026-27 routes and schedules are unconfirmed.

transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: the town's free buses and the free gondola from town lots to the Peak 7 and Peak 8 bases. 2026-27 schedules are unconfirmed.

research.confidenceNotes: Upgraded on 2026-09-30 from reference-only using batched web searches (search-result summaries; page fetching is blocked, so no official page was read directly). Search-summary facts: planned 2026-27 opening, terrain and lift stats, 2026-27 prices, a projected closing (notes only) and the lift-status link. Still Piste reference data (unverified): identity, coordinates and weather points, operator, elevations, features, airport drive estimates and transfers. Summaries sometimes blend several result pages, so the source URL on each fact group is the most specific result that carried it — confirm at source before relying on it. Snow-report, lift-status and trail-map links follow the URL pattern shared by all Vail Resorts sites (the terrain-and-lift-status and mountain-info pages were seen in results for Breckenridge itself); they were not individually opened.
